The '''Naweenen Fate Rooms''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The decor of the [[Casino Kuari]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] was modelled after the location.
